projects.name: : FGI – AVO
projects.client: Future Generali India Insurance Company Ltd.
projects.description:
Future Generali Insurance Company Limited (FG) has chosen ‘Agent Virtual Office (AVO)’ Solutions for implementation
as their Portal for Intermediaries. AVO is a one-stop solution for all intermediaries.
1. AVO enables insurance companies in setting up different level of privileges to different intermediaries through
user management module.
2. AVO aids intermediaries to generate Quick Quotes, proposals, issue policies/recover notes for all Straight through
processing (STP) cases. For NSTP (Non-STP), AVO enables a workflow between Underwriters (UW) and IMD to
reduce the turnaround time (TAT) in achieving quick sales ratio.
3. AVO enables intermediaries by providing self-service options like download of product catalogs/online product
training, track the business figures via dashboards

projects.name: : (RECLS) - Life Science
projects.description:
Healthcare providers are important customers of pharmaceutical and medtech manufacturers. To ensure you get a fair net
price for your products, you must be able to find the right combination of upfront net pricing agreements, pricing value drivers,
and periodic backend rebates. But managing different pricing and agreements for group purchasing organizations (GPOs),
integrated delivery networks (IDNs), health systems, and hospitals is no small task.
